summary.name: Resilience Roundup
summary.one_liner: A newsletter offering weekly analysis of Resilience Engineering and Human Factors research aimed at software systems.
keywords: when to call for help during incidents
use_cases: Keeping up with resilience engineering research
Reading about human factors in software incidents
Learning how automation and AI affect operator teams
Finding past newsletter issues on incident response
summary.what_it_does: The page promotes the Resilience Roundup newsletter, which is described as a weekly analysis of Resilience Engineering and Human Factors research designed for software systems. Visitors can subscribe by email through a magic-link sign-up. The page lists three recent issues, with titles on automation as a 'team player' in the age of AI, knowing when to call for help in incident response, and management by exception. A link leads to an archive of past issues. The page text does not describe further features or tools.
notable: Weekly analysis of resilience engineering and human factors research for software systems
caveats: Pricing and paid tiers are not stated on the page
Content is a newsletter, not a software tool
